result.instructions: Tools for Gandi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our domains expire in the next 60 days?"; "Show the DNS records for example.com."; "Point the www record of example.com to 192.0.2.10 with a 3600 second TTL.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Gandi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gandi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gandi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gandi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. gandi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gandi_list_domains
tools.title: List domains
tools.description: List the domains owned by the token's user, with status, registry dates, autorenew and nameserver type. Gandi API: GET /v5/domain/domains.

fqdn.description: Filter by name, with optional patterns such as example.* or *example.com.

tld.description: Filter by extension, for example com.

sharing_id.description: Organization id to list under (sharing_id filter).

tools.name: gandi_get_domain
tools.title: Get a domain
tools.description: Get one domain with its status, life-cycle dates (registry_ends_at, renew_begins_at, hold_begins_at), autorenew and nameserver mode. Gandi API: GET /v5/domain/domains/{domain}.

tools.name: gandi_list_expiring_domains
tools.title: List domains expiring soon
tools.description: List domains whose registry end date falls within the next N days (or has passed), soonest first. Reads up to max_pages pages of 100 domains; check complete in the result. Built from GET /v5/domain/domains.

max_pages.description: Pages of 100 domains to read (default 5, max 10).

tools.name: gandi_list_livedns_domains
tools.title: List LiveDNS domains
tools.description: List the domains whose DNS is hosted in Gandi LiveDNS. Gandi API: GET /v5/livedns/domains.

sharing_id.description: Organization id to list under (sharing_id filter).

tools.name: gandi_list_zone_records
tools.title: List zone records
tools.description: List all DNS record sets in a LiveDNS zone, with name, type, TTL and values. Gandi API: GET /v5/livedns/domains/{fqdn}/records.

tools.name: gandi_get_zone_record
tools.title: Get a zone record
tools.description: Get one DNS record set by zone, name and type. Returns 404 when the name and type pair does not exist. Gandi API: GET /v5/livedns/domains/{fqdn}/records/{rrset_name}/{rrset_type}.

rrset_name.description: Record name relative to the zone. Use '@' for the zone apex, or 'www' for www.<domain>.

rrset_type.description: Record type, for example A, AAAA, CNAME, MX or TXT.

tools.name: gandi_create_zone_record
tools.title: Create a zone record
tools.description: Create a DNS record set in a LiveDNS zone. It changes live DNS for the domain. Fails when the name and type pair already exists; use gandi_update_zone_record to change it. Gandi API: POST /v5/livedns/domains/{fqdn}/records/{rrset_name}/{rrset_type}.

rrset_name.description: Record name relative to the zone. Use '@' for the zone apex, or 'www' for www.<domain>.

rrset_type.description: Record type, for example A, AAAA, CNAME, MX or TXT.

rrset_values.description: All values of the record set. For example ['192.0.2.10'] for an A record.

rrset_ttl.description: Cache time in seconds (300 to 2592000). Omit to keep the API default.

tools.name: gandi_update_zone_record
tools.title: Update a zone record
tools.description: Replace all values (and optionally the TTL) of one DNS record set. It changes live DNS for the domain and drops the old values. Safe to repeat with the same input. Gandi API: PUT /v5/livedns/domains/{fqdn}/records/{rrset_name}/{rrset_type}.

rrset_name.description: Record name relative to the zone. Use '@' for the zone apex, or 'www' for www.<domain>.

rrset_type.description: Record type, for example A, AAAA, CNAME, MX or TXT.

rrset_values.description: All values of the record set. For example ['192.0.2.10'] for an A record.

rrset_ttl.description: Cache time in seconds (300 to 2592000). Omit to keep the API default.
